name: Men Going Their Own Way
scope: The online male-separatist community that calls itself MGTOW (Men Going Their Own Way), from its early-2000s forums to today's subreddits, forums and YouTube channels: men who hold that society is gynocentric and corrupted by feminism and that the remedy is individual withdrawal from relationships with women, marriage and, at the furthest level, from much of society, not political lobbying. Defining sources: ethnography and communications scholarship (Lin; Jones, Trott and Wright; Horta Ribeiro et al.), the SPLC's account of it as a male supremacist community, and the community's own glossary and FAQ at mgtow.com. Excludes the broader manosphere as such (men's rights activism, pickup artists, incels, Red Pill communities), which are separate subjects, and the opposing 'men's rights' strand of political activism.
summary: MGTOW hold that Western society is gynocentric and rigged against men, that feminism has made women dangerous to men and that the system cannot be reformed. Their answer is individual separation: avoid marriage, cohabitation and committed relationships with women, pursue self-reliance, and (at the 'ghost' level) minimise engagement with state and society. They describe themselves as a lifestyle rather than a movement.
